headline: Kolkata's sewage-treatment promises
intro: Dated commitments from KMC's own statutory filings and from the ADB-disclosed KMC-SHARP programme. The 2021 Environment Plan entries carry deadlines but no follow-up, so they sit at 'unverified'. The KMC-SHARP packages are the opposite: named contractors, contractual completion dates and a percentage-progress figure refreshed every six months by an ADB disclosure obligation rather than at the implementing agency's discretion. Five of them commenced on 15 October 2025 and every one stood at 0.0% physical progress on 31 December 2025 - a baseline the next report either moves or does not.

status_legend.delivered: Done, with a source confirming it
status_legend.slipped: Officially or credibly re-dated - both dates kept
status_legend.overdue: Past its promised date with no official word
status_legend.unverified: A change may have happened; awaiting a citable confirmation

commitments.title: Commission the 45 MLD STP at Near WBSETCL, Joka
commitments.what: KMC's District Environment Plan 2021 records this plant at 17% completion with a stated timeline of March, 2022 - a deadline already less than four months away when the plan was filed on 1 December 2021. No later public document confirming completion or re-dating has been found.

commitment_source.label: Kolkata Municipal Corporation, District Environment Plan 2021 - Kolkata, p.29

status_history.note: Deadline is four years past. No KEIIP or KMC document confirming commissioning, slippage or a revised date has been located, so the status cannot move to delivered or overdue without inventing evidence.

commitments.title: Commission the 41 MLD STP at Anandapur, Ward 108
commitments.committed_by: Kolkata Municipal Corporation / KMC SHARP, financed by the Asian Development Bank
commitments.what: KMC's 2021 Environment Plan listed a 70 MLD plant for Borough-XII with no timeline, to be built 'based on implementation of future loan or from own resources'. The loan arrived: this is now a 41 MLD Sequencing batch reactor (SBR) plant under KMC SHARP (ADB project 56287-001), package KMC SHARP/OCB/SD 04/2025-26, with bids invited march 2026; 3.5-year design-and-construction period, then 15 years o&m. Originally sited at Hossainpur in the SAME ward under the same package, with a draft IEE disclosed via ADB in 2024. Relocated after legal litigation made that land parcel unavailable; the new site is within 2.5 km. It is being built on KMDA-owned, currently a non-operational oxidation pond, discharging to Lead Channel D-D1, to NGT effluent standards.

commitment_source.label: KMC/ADB, Updated Initial Environmental Examination, 24 Feb 2026

status_history.note: Listed at 70 MLD for Borough-XII with no timeline and no committed funding
Financed and scheduled: 41 MLD at Anandapur, bids March 2026, 3.5-year build. Capacity is 41 MLD, not the 70 MLD proposed in 2021, and the site moved after litigation.
status_history.source_label: KMC/ADB, Updated Initial Environmental Examination, 24 Feb 2026

commitments.title: SD01: sewerage and drainage in Nayabad and adjoining areas
commitments.committed_by: Kolkata Municipal Corporation, KMC-SHARP programme, financed by the Asian Development Bank (Loan 4584-IND)
commitments.what: 8.4 km combined RCC sewer network, 981 catch pits, 52 gully pits, 466 manholes, house service connections, and five gravity outfalls discharging storm-water flow into the Guniagachi canal in the Tollygunge-Panchanangram basin. update_model: Statuses change only with a dated citation; every change appends to the commitment's history, and the slippage trail is the product. Kolkata's verification calendar is now real: KMC-SHARP publishes a Semi Annual Environment Monitoring Report through ADB, so these packages have a fixed six-monthly checkpoint. The 2021 KEIIP-era entries have no such calendar, which is precisely why they remain unverified.
sources_note: KMC District Environment Plan 2021 (2021-12-01); KMC-SHARP Semi Annual Environment Monitoring Report Jul-Dec 2025, ADB Loan 4584-IND, via keiip.in
